11: verus! {
12: 
13: pub type NodeId = nat;
14: pub type LogIdx = nat;
15: 
16: #[verus::trusted]
17: pub trait Dispatch: Sized {
18:     type WriteOperation: Sized + Send;
19: }
20: 
21: pub tracked struct LogEntry<DT: Dispatch> {
22:     pub op: DT::WriteOperation,
23:     pub node_id: NodeId,
24: }
25: 
26: pub struct ConcreteLogEntry<DT: Dispatch> {
27:     pub op: DT::WriteOperation,
28:     pub node_id: u64,
29: }
30: 
31: pub open const LOG_SIZE: usize = 512 * 1024;
32: 
33: pub open spec fn map_contains_value<K, V>(map: Map<K, V>, val: V) -> bool {
34:     exists|i: K| #[trigger] map.contains_key(i) && map.index(i) == val
35: }

37: #[verifier(nonlinear)]
38: #[verifier::external_body]
39: pub proof fn int_mod_less_than_same(i: int, len: int)
40:     requires 0 <= i < len, len > 0,
41:     ensures (i % len) == i,
42: { unimplemented!() }

44: }

46: tokenized_state_machine! {
47: UnboundedLog<DT: Dispatch> {
48:     fields {
49:         #[sharding(map)]
50:         pub log: Map<LogIdx, LogEntry<DT>>,
51:     }
52: 
53:     init! {

56:         }
57:     }
58: }

62: verus! {
63: 
64: pub type LogicalLogIdx = int;
65: 
66: 
67: pub tracked struct StoredType<DT: Dispatch> {
68:     pub cell_perms: PointsTo<Option<ConcreteLogEntry<DT>>>,
69:     pub log_entry: Option<UnboundedLog::log<DT>>,
70: }
71: 
72: pub open spec fn stored_type_inv<DT: Dispatch>(
73:     st: StoredType<DT>,
74:     idx: int,
75:     cell_id: CellId,
76:     unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>,
77: ) -> bool {
78:     &&& st.cell_perms.mem_contents().is_init()
79:     &&& st.cell_perms@.pcell == cell_id
80:     &&& idx >= 0 ==> {
81:         &&& st.log_entry matches Some(log_entry)
82:         &&& log_entry.key() == idx
83:         &&& log_entry.instance_id() == unbounded_log_instance.id()
84:         &&& st.cell_perms.mem_contents().value() matches Some(cell_perms_value)
85:         &&& cell_perms_value.node_id as NodeId
86:             == log_entry.value().node_id
87:         &&& cell_perms_value.op == log_entry.value().op
88:     }
89:     &&& idx < 0 ==> {
90:         &&& true
91:     }
92: }
93: 
94: #[is_variant]
95: pub tracked enum ReaderState<DT: Dispatch> {
96:     Starting {
97:         start: LogIdx,
98:     },
99:     Range { start: LogIdx, end: LogIdx, cur: LogIdx },
100:     Guard { start: LogIdx, end: LogIdx, cur: LogIdx, val: StoredType<DT> },
101: }
102: 
103: #[is_variant]
104: pub tracked enum CombinerState<DT: Dispatch> {
105:     Idle,
106:     Reading(ReaderState<DT>),
107:     AdvancingHead { idx: LogIdx, min_local_version: LogIdx },
108:     AdvancingTail { observed_head: LogIdx },
109:     Appending { cur_idx: LogIdx, tail: LogIdx },
110: }
111: 
112: impl<DT: Dispatch> CombinerState<DT> {
113:     pub open spec fn no_overlap_with(self, other: Self) -> bool {
114:         match self {
115:             CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } => {
116:                 match other {
117:                     CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard { start, end, cur, val }) => {
118:                         (cur_idx > cur)  
119:                          || (tail <= cur)  
120: 
121:                     },
122:                     CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: cur_idx2, tail: tail2 } => {
123:                         (cur_idx >= tail2)  
124:                          || (tail <= cur_idx2)  
125: 
126:                     },
127:                     _ => { true },
128:                 }
129:             },
130:             _ => { true },
131:         }
132:     }
133: }
134: 
135: tokenized_state_machine! { CyclicBuffer<DT: Dispatch> {
136:     fields {
137:         #[sharding(constant)]
138:         pub unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance::<DT>,
139: 
140:         #[sharding(constant)]
141:         pub cell_ids: Seq<CellId>,
142: 
143:         #[sharding(constant)]
144:         pub buffer_size: LogIdx,
145: 
146:         #[sharding(constant)]
147:         pub num_replicas: nat,
148: 
149: 
150:         #[sharding(variable)]
151:         pub head: LogIdx,
152: 
153: 
154:         #[sharding(variable)]
155:         pub tail: LogIdx,
156: 
157: 
158:         #[sharding(map)]
159:         pub local_versions: Map<NodeId, LogIdx>,    
160: 
161:         #[sharding(storage_map)]
162:         pub contents: Map<LogicalLogIdx, StoredType<DT>>,
163: 
164: 
165:         #[sharding(map)]
166:         pub alive_bits: Map<             LogIdx,            bool>,
167: 
168:         #[sharding(map)]
169:         pub combiner: Map<NodeId, CombinerState<DT>>
170:     }
171: 
172: 
173: 
174: 
175:     #[invariant]
176:     pub spec fn log_size(&self) -> bool {
177:         self.buffer_size == LOG_SIZE
178:     }
179: 
180:     #[invariant]
181:     pub spec fn cell_ids(&self) -> bool {
182:         self.cell_ids.len() == self.buffer_size
183:     }
184: 
185:     #[invariant]
186:     pub spec fn complete(&self) -> bool {
187:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.num_replicas <==> self.local_versions.contains_key(i))
188:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.buffer_size  <==> self.alive_bits.contains_key(i))
189:         &&& (forall |i| 0 <= i < self.num_replicas <==> self.combiner.contains_key(i))
190:         &&& (forall |i| self.contents.contains_key(i) ==> -self.buffer_size <= i < self.tail)
191:     }
192: 
193:     #[invariant]
194:     pub spec fn pointer_ordering(&self) -> bool {
195:         &&& self.head <= self.tail
196:         &&& (forall |i| #[trigger] self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
197:             self.head <= self.local_versions[i] <= self.tail)
198:         &&& (forall |i| #[trigger] self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
199:             self.tail <= self.local_versions[i] +  self.buffer_size)
200:     }
201: 
202:     #[invariant]
203:     pub spec fn pointer_differences(&self) -> bool {
204:         forall |i| self.local_versions.contains_key(i) ==>
205:             self.local_versions[i] <= self.tail <= self.local_versions[i] + self.buffer_size
206:     }
207: 
208:     #[invariant]
209:     pub spec fn ranges_no_overlap(&self) -> bool {
210:         (forall |i, j| self.combiner.contains_key(i) && self.combiner.contains_key(j) && i != j ==>
211:             self.combiner[i].no_overlap_with(self.combiner[j])
212:         )
213:     }
214: 
215:     #[invariant]
216:     pub spec fn upcoming_bits_are_not_alive(&self) -> bool {
217:         let min_local_head = map_min_value(self.local_versions, (self.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
218:         forall |i|
219:             self.tail <= i < min_local_head + self.buffer_size
220:             ==> !log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size)
221:     }
222: 
223:     #[invariant]
224:     pub spec fn inv_buffer_contents(&self) -> bool {
225:         &&& (forall |i: int| self.tail - self.buffer_size <= i < self.tail ==> (
226:             (log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size) ||
227:                 i < map_min_value(self.local_versions, (self.num_replicas - 1) as nat))
228:             <==>
229:             #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i)
230:         ))
231:         &&& (forall |i: int| self.tail <= i ==> ! #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i))
232:     }
233: 
234:     #[invariant]
235:     pub spec fn contents_meet_inv(&self) -> bool {
236:         forall |i: int| #[trigger] self.contents.contains_key(i) ==>
237:             stored_type_inv(self.contents[i], i, self.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, self.buffer_size) as int], self.unbounded_log_instance)
238:     }
239: 
240:     #[invariant]
241:     pub spec fn all_reader_state_valid(&self) -> bool {
242:         forall |node_id| #![trigger self.combiner[node_id]] #[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id) && self.combiner[node_id].is_Reading() ==>
243:           self.reader_state_valid(node_id, self.combiner[node_id].get_Reading_0())
244:     }
245: 
246:     pub closed spec fn reader_state_valid(&self, node_id: NodeId, rs: ReaderState<DT>) -> bool {
247:         match rs {
248:             ReaderState::Starting{start} => {
249:                 &&& start == self.local_versions[node_id]
250:                 &&& start <= self.tail
251:             }
252:             ReaderState::Range{start, end, cur} => {
253:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] == start
254:                 &&& start <= end
255:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= end <= (self.tail as int)
256:                 &&& start <= cur <= end
257:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i < cur ==> log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size))
258:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i < cur ==> self.contents.contains_key(i))
259:             }
260:             ReaderState::Guard{start, end, cur, val} => {
261:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] == start
262:                 &&& start <= end
263:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= end <= (self.tail as int)
264:                 &&& start <= cur < end
265:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i <= cur ==> log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i, self.buffer_size))
266:                 &&& (forall |i| start <= i <= cur ==> self.contents.contains_key(i))
267:                 &&& self.contents.contains_key(cur as int)
268:                 &&& self.contents[cur as int] === val
269:             }
270:         }
271:     }
272: 
273:     #[invariant]
274:     pub spec fn all_combiner_valid(&self) -> bool {
275:         forall |node_id| #[trigger] self.combiner.contains_key(node_id) ==>
276:           self.combiner_valid(node_id, self.combiner[node_id])
277:     }
278: 
279:     pub closed spec fn combiner_valid(&self, node_id: NodeId, cs: CombinerState<DT>) -> bool {
280:         match cs {
281:             CombinerState::Idle => true,
282:             CombinerState::Reading(_) => true, 
283:             CombinerState::AdvancingHead{idx, min_local_version} => {
284:                 &&& idx <= self.num_replicas as nat
285:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < idx ==> min_local_version <= self.local_versions[n])
286:             }
287:             CombinerState::AdvancingTail{observed_head} => {
288:                 &&& (forall |n| 0 <= n < self.num_replicas as nat ==> observed_head <= self.local_versions[n])
289:             }
290:             CombinerState::Appending{cur_idx, tail} => {
291:                 &&& self.local_versions[node_id] <= cur_idx <= tail
292:                 &&& tail <= self.tail
293:                 &&& (self.tail as int) - (self.buffer_size as int) <= cur_idx <= (self.tail as int)
294:                 &&& (forall |i : nat| cur_idx <= i < tail ==> (
295:                   !(log_entry_is_alive(self.alive_bits, i as int, self.buffer_size))))
296:             }
297:         }
298:     }
299: 
300: 
301: 
302:     init!{
303:         initialize(buffer_size: nat, num_replicas: nat, contents: Map<int, StoredType<DT>>, cell_ids: Seq<CellId>, unbounded_log_instance: UnboundedLog::Instance<DT>, ) {
304:             require(num_replicas > 0);
305:             require(buffer_size == LOG_SIZE);
306:             require(cell_ids.len() == buffer_size);
307: 
308:             init unbounded_log_instance = unbounded_log_instance;
309:             init cell_ids = cell_ids;
310:             init buffer_size = buffer_size;
311:             init num_replicas = num_replicas;
312:             init head = 0;
313:             init tail = 0;
314:             init local_versions = Map::new(Set::range(0, num_replicas), |i: NodeId| 0);
315: 
316:             require(forall |i: int| (-buffer_size <= i < 0 <==> contents.contains_key(i)));
317:             require(forall |i: int| #[trigger] contents.contains_key(i) ==> stored_type_inv(contents[i], i, cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, buffer_size) as int], unbounded_log_instance));
318:             init contents = contents;
319: 
320:             init alive_bits = Map::new(Set::range(0, buffer_size), |i: nat| !log_entry_alive_value(i as int, buffer_size));
321:             init combiner = Map::new(Set::range(0, num_replicas), |i: NodeId| CombinerState::Idle);
322:         }
323:     }

327:     transition!{
328:         reader_start(node_id: NodeId) {
329:             have   local_versions    >= [ node_id => let local_head ];
330: 
331:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
332:             add    combiner += [
333:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start: local_head })
334:             ];
335:         }
336:     }
337: 
338:     transition!{
339:         reader_enter(node_id: NodeId) {
340:             remove combiner -= [
341:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Starting { start })
342:             ];
343:             add combiner += [
344:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range { start, end: pre.tail, cur: start })
345:             ];
346:             assert start <= pre.tail;
347:         }
348:     }
349: 
350:     transition!{
351:         reader_guard(node_id: NodeId) {
352:             remove combiner -= [
353:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
354:             ];
355: 
356:             require(cur < end);
357: 
358:             have alive_bits >= [ log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) => log_entry_alive_value(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) ];
359: 
360:             birds_eye let val = pre.contents.index(cur as int);
361: 
362:             add combiner += [
363:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
364:             ];
365: 
366:         }
367:     }
368: 
369:     property!{
370:         guard_guards(node_id: NodeId) {
371:             have combiner >= [
372:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading( ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
373:             ];
374:             guard contents >= [ cur as int => val ];
375: 
376:             assert(stored_type_inv(val, cur as int, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(cur as int, pre.buffer_size) as int],  pre.unbounded_log_instance));
377:         }
378:     }
379: 
380:     transition!{
381:         reader_unguard(node_id: NodeId) {
382:             remove combiner -= [
383:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Guard{ start, end, cur, val })
384:             ];
385:             add combiner += [
386:                 node_id => CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur: cur + 1 })
387:             ];
388:         }
389:     }

391:     transition!{
392:         reader_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
393:             remove combiner -= [
394:                 node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(ReaderState::Range{ start, end, cur })
395:             ];
396:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
397: 
398:             remove local_versions -= [ node_id => let _ ];
399:             add    local_versions += [ node_id => end ];
400: 
401:             require(cur == end);
402:         }
403:     }
404: 
405:     transition!{
406:         reader_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
407:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Reading(r) ];
408:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
409: 
410:             require(r.is_Starting() || r.is_Range());
411:         }
412:     }
413: 
414: 
415: 
416:     transition!{
417:         advance_head_start(node_id: NodeId) {
418:             have   local_versions >= [ 0 => let local_head_0 ];
419:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
420:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: 1, min_local_version: local_head_0,} ];

422:     }

426:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
427: 
428:             have   local_versions    >= [ idx => let local_head_at_idx ];
429:             require(idx < pre.num_replicas);
430: 
431:             let new_min = min(min_local_version, local_head_at_idx);
432:             add combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx: idx + 1, min_local_version: new_min } ];
433:         }
434:     }
435: 
436:     transition!{
437:         advance_head_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
438:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { idx, min_local_version } ];
439:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
440:             update head      = min_local_version;
441: 
442:             require(idx == pre.num_replicas);
443:         }
444:     }
445: 
446:     transition!{
447:         advance_head_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
448:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingHead { .. } ];
449:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
450:         }
451:     }

454: 
455:     transition!{
456:         advance_tail_start(node_id: NodeId) {
457:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
458:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::AdvancingTail { observed_head: pre.head } ];
459:         }
460:     }
461: 
462:     transition!{
463:         advance_tail_finish(node_id: NodeId, new_tail: nat) {
464:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingTail { observed_head } ];
465:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: pre.tail, tail: new_tail } ];
466:             update tail      = new_tail;
467: 
468:             require(pre.tail <= new_tail <= observed_head + pre.buffer_size);
469: 
470:             birds_eye let withdrawn = Map::new(
471:                 Set::range(pre.tail - pre.buffer_size, new_tail - pre.buffer_size),
472:                 |i: int| pre.contents[i],
473:             );
474: 
475:             withdraw contents -= (withdrawn) by {
476:                 assert forall |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size implies pre.contents.contains_key(i) by {
477:                     let min_local_head = map_min_value(pre.local_versions, (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
478:                     map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
479:                 }
480:             };
481: 
482:             assert forall
483:               |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size
484:                 ==> stored_type_inv(#[trigger] withdrawn[i], i, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, pre.buffer_size) as int], pre.unbounded_log_instance) by {
485: 
486:                 assert forall
487:                   |i: int| pre.tail - pre.buffer_size <= i < new_tail - pre.buffer_size
488:                     implies stored_type_inv(#[trigger] withdrawn[i], i, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(i, pre.buffer_size) as int], pre.unbounded_log_instance) by {
489:                         assert(pre.contents.contains_key(i) && #[trigger] withdrawn.contains_key(i)) by {
490:                             let min_local_head = map_min_value(pre.local_versions, (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
491:                             map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
492:                         };
493:                     };
494:                 };
495:         }
496:     }
497: 
498:     transition!{
499:         advance_tail_abort(node_id: NodeId) {
500:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::AdvancingTail { .. } ];
501:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Idle ];
502:         }
503:     }
504: 
505: 
506: 
507: 
508:     transition!{
509:         append_flip_bit(node_id: NodeId, deposited: StoredType<DT>) {
510:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } ];
511:             add    combiner += [ node_id => CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx: cur_idx + 1, tail } ];
512: 
513:             remove alive_bits -= [ log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size) => let bit ];
514:             add    alive_bits += [ log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size) => log_entry_alive_value(cur_idx  as int, pre.buffer_size) ];
515: 
516:             require(cur_idx < tail);
517:             require(stored_type_inv(deposited, cur_idx as int, pre.cell_ids[log_entry_idx(cur_idx as int, pre.buffer_size) as int],  pre.unbounded_log_instance));
518: 
519:             deposit contents += [ cur_idx as int => deposited ] by {
520:                 map_min_value_smallest(pre.local_versions,  (pre.num_replicas - 1) as nat);
521:             };
522:         }
523:     }

525:     transition!{
526:         append_finish(node_id: NodeId) {
527:             remove combiner -= [ node_id => let CombinerState::Appending { cur_idx, tail } ];
